تستعطفون (form X)
# تَسْتَعْطِفُونَ (tastaʕṭifūna) /tas.taʕ.tˤi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# تُسْتَعْطَفُونَ (tustaʕṭafūna) /tus.taʕ.tˤa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
